nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances in QuantChain; updated via unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of spend allowances; written by approve and transferFrom, and pre-set for the UNI router in the constructor.
Constant public decimals = 18.
Public total supply; set once in the constructor to _supply.
Public token name string; set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string; set in the constructor.
Private privileged owner address; gates delegate and batchSend via require(msg.sender == owner).
Constant internal UNI router address 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D used in allowance setup.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the ensure modifier; moves balances and mutates allowance using raw unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Owner-only function performing a arbitrary-target delegatecall(a, b); allows executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
Owner-only loop that sends _value to each entry of _tos; uses unchecked multiplication and unchecked balance arithmetic.
Internal pure Uniswap-style pair address computation using keccak256 and the init code hash constant.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balance and unlimited UNI allowance.
Modifier that recomputes the UNI pair via pairFor and requires _from or _to to be owner or _from to be UNI.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, transfers and initial ownership assignment.
delegatecall to an arbitrary caller-supplied address in delegate; arbitrary code execution inside contract storage.
total = _value * _tos.length computed without SafeMath, subject to integer overflow.
Raw -= / += operations on balanceOf and allowance mappings without SafeMath guards.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
transfer invokes transferFrom internally.
transferFrom compares msg.sender against _from and debits allowance[msg.sender].
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
delegate executes a delegatecall to the caller-supplied address a.
Parameter a is the untrusted target of the delegatecall.
Parameter b supplies arbitrary calldata to the delegatecall.
batchSend is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
batchSend mutates balanceOf with raw -= and += operations.
batchSend credits balanceOf[_to] and debits balanceOf[msg.sender].
transferFrom updates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
The ensure modifier calls pairFor to recompute the UNI pair address.
transferFrom is guarded by the ensure(_from, _to) modifier.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor derives privileged owner from msg.sender.
Constructor sets balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
Constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router address.
Constructor sets totalSupply = _supply.
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
